name: unambiguous-date
title: Unambiguous Date
description: Date display that writes dates as "3 Oct 2026" with distance from today, flags numeric inputs that read two ways (DD/MM vs MM/DD) with a one-tap choice, and lets one answer apply to a whole imported column.

meta.stops: 03/04 read as March instead of April
meta.summary: Shows numeric dates as "3 Oct 2026" and asks when 03/10 could mean two dates, so DD/MM and MM/DD aren't mixed up.
catches: Numeric dates with two valid readings (03/10/2026)
Impossible dates like 31/02, rejected instead of rolled over
One answer applied to every date in a column
limits: Numeric formats only; month names are not parsed here
a11y: Readback in a polite live region with a <time dateTime> element
Choice buttons are labelled; focus moves to the chosen reading
